```yaml
id: vuln-portofino-94653cb3
languages:
  - java
message: Detected usage of insecure temporary file creation
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2022-3952
  CWE: CWE-377, CWE-668
pattern: |
  method(name="createTempDir" 
    parameter-count=1 
    returns="java.io.File" 
    pattern-either(
      pattern-regexp(string="File tempDir = File.createTempFile(\"portofino.tomcat.\", \".\" + port);", regex=".*File tempDir = File.createTempFile\\(\"portofino.tomcat.\", \".\" + port\\);.*"),
      pattern-regexp(string="File tempDir = Files.createTempDirectory(\"portofino.tomcat.\" + \".\" + port).toFile();", regex=".*File tempDir = Files.createTempDirectory\\(\"portofino.tomcat.\" + \".\" + port\\).toFile\\(\\);.*")
    )
  )
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the usage of the `File.createTempFile` method in the `createTempDir` method. It will also detect the usage of `Files.createTempDirectory`. The rule is set to have a severity of ERROR, indicating a high level of confidence that this vulnerability exists.
